source_conflicts.description: The program text (hesbernosaf) names 11 specialization areas (מערכות מחשב, תקשורת, בקרה ומערכות אוטונומיות, עיבוד אותות, התקנים אלקטרוניים, אלקטרואופטיקה ופוטוניקה, אלקטרומגנטיות וקרינה, אנרגיה ומקורות מתחדשים, תקשורות ואינפורמציה קוונטית, ביו-אלקטרוניקה, חומרים); the program tree has 14 track sections (adds VLSI, machine learning/AI and multidisciplinary, and names some differently). The spec follows the tree's track sections.
Advanced-labs hours: the Year-4 section says 6-8 ש"ס, the years 3-4 section says 5-8 ש"ס (both 3-6.5 weighted). The spec states no lab hours (category advanced_labs: min_courses 2).

The overlap note on 0512-4506 names "מבוא לאלקטרניקת הספק 05124506" - its own number; the course called מבוא לאלקטרוניקת הספק on the same page is 0512-4507. Not resolved; see course_rules[excl-0512-4506-as-printed].
IMS 2026 lists 0510-6404 as offered (semester A) but the program timetable has no group for it. The spec keeps it (IMS).

The program page lists these courses without the cancelled flag, but IMS 2026 says not offered and the program timetable has no group: 0510-7400, 0510-7438, 0510-7650, 0512-4262, 0512-4364, 0512-4493, 0512-4507, 0555-4000, 0581-4321, 0581-5312. The spec follows IMS + timetable and leaves them out of the elective pools (not plannable in תשפ"ז); 0512-4262 is also marked core (see course_rules[core-four-distinct-tracks]).

course_rules.note: TAU: 12 track courses over the degree (labs excluded), of which at least 4 are marked "קורס ליבה" and come from 4 different tracks. The core marking exists only in each listing's course note ("קורס ליבה במסלול X"; the listing data has no core field) and is attributed to the track the note names, not the section it is listed under (e.g. 0512-4264 is listed in 5 tracks, core of ml_ai only; 0512-4601 is core of optics_photonics and bioelectronics). Core courses not taught in תשפ"ז (IMS not_offered): 0512-4262, 0555-4551. Nothing enforces this: the board has no core marking, and the 12-course minimum lives only in group_minimums.track (spec_to_program emits only the 'core' group to the board as core_courses_total_min), so the planner checks neither.

TAU: 2 advanced labs from 2 different tracks; a student who takes both in the same track must take a third lab in another track, whose credits do not count toward the theoretical-course credits. category_members keys are the track categories; the labs themselves sit in the advanced_labs category (min_courses 2). The board enforces only the count of 2 (category advanced_labs), not the distinct-track condition nor the third-lab rule.

params.applies_to: students who began higher education from תשפ"ב

course_rules.note: TAU (hesbernosaf, per the Council for Higher Education): every student who began higher education in Israel from תשפ"ב studies at least two courses in English during the bachelor's degree. The coverage item itself maps to total_required_credits (same text); the board has no language-of-instruction field.
TAU: 0512-4264 overlaps 0368-3235 (מבוא ללמידה חישובית); both cannot be taken during the degree. The board has no exclusion data.
TAU: 0512-1820 partly overlaps 0368-2161 (פרויקט תוכנה); both cannot be taken. The board has no exclusion data.

TAU: 0512-4400 overlaps 0512-4495 (מבנה המחשב ומערכות הפעלה); both cannot be taken. The note items are mapped to core-four-distinct-tracks (the same note marks 0512-4400 core). The board has no exclusion data.

TAU: 0512-4402 overlaps 0368-2162 (מערכות הפעלה); both cannot be taken (the same note says it is not meant for computer-engineering students, which does not restrict this program). The board has no exclusion data.
TAU: 0512-4861 overlaps 0512-4860 (מעגלי RF); both cannot be taken. The board has no exclusion data.

TAU: 0512-4506 (אלקטרוניקת הספק) "overlaps מבוא לאלקטרניקת הספק 05124506" and both cannot be taken. The note names the course's own number; on the same page מבוא לאלקטרוניקת הספק is 0512-4507. Not resolved: recorded in source_conflicts, the second course is left out of course_ids. The board has no exclusion data.
TAU: spring-intake students (מחזור אביב) who want 0512-4162 must take it in semester 5. Neither the spec nor the board models intake cohorts.
TAU: 0509-4010 can be taken only in year 4, with an average of 85+, after an admission interview. The board's track placement does not restrict it to year 4.

TAU: 0512-3000 (פרויקט מיוחד) can be registered from semester 3 on, manually, on the project supervisor's recommendation. The board offers track courses in years 3-4 only, which is narrower than the rule; nothing encodes semester 3.

TAU: in semester 2 or 3 one may take one elective, 0512-4013 (מעבדת חשיפה לחומרה). Optional ("ניתן לקחת"): category hardware_exposure_elective has min_courses 0. The built boards do not encode the window: data/boards/electrical_engineering_years_1_2_2027.json offers it in all of year_1_semester_a..year_2_semester_b (semesters 1-4) and data/boards/electrical_engineering_2027.json in year_3_semester_a..year_4_semester_b.

TAU: 0512-4013 is for year-1 (semester B) and year-2 (semester A) EE students who met every recommended-plan requirement and hold an average of 85+ (registration by bidding). The board models neither averages nor plan completion.

known_gaps.description: The faculty undergraduate regulations (תקנון הלימודים לתואר ראשון, https://engineering.tau.ac.il/sites/engineering.tau.ac.il/files/media_server/Engineering/yedion/Terms_BA.pdf) are only linked from the program page and were not read; they may hold planning rules (e.g. semester load limits, repeat or exemption rules) the spec does not express.
